verdict.rationale: The evidence describes App Lock, export passwords, and biometric/PIN sign-in as end-user-controlled toggles, not admin-enforced org-wide policies; docs-3 vaguely notes some settings are 'if allowed by your administrator' but no evidence shows an admin console or org-wide policy enforcement over app lock, export restriction, or credential strength. Community evidence (comm-6) even states Microsoft doesn't give admins tools to disable/restrict certain app behaviors, reinforcing the gap rather than confirming the capability.
